name: Toroi
source: A trojan horse virus trainee who hopes to become a strong virus one day. Because she is a trainee, her skills as a virus aren't that strong. When Yuuichi encounters her, his computer is filled with popups, but there was only a limited number of them, so it wasn't a big deal in the end.
translation: A trojan horse virus trainee who hopes to become a strong virus one day. Because she is a trainee, her skills as a virus aren't that strong. When Yuuichi encounters her, his computer is filled with popups, but there was only a limited number of them, so it wasn't a big deal in the end.
